description: Saves a PG / co-living alert for this query after the seeker agrees to share their email with partners whose listings match, and emails them when a bed matches. Requires consent true. Does not accept a phone number.

amenities.description: PG property amenities (all required must be present on the listing).

attached_bath.description: True only when an attached bath is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

consent.description: True only when the seeker has explicitly agreed, for this query, to share this email with partners whose listings match.

has_ac.description: True only when AC is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

locality.description: Exact area inside the city, such as Baner or Kharadi. A Baner search does not return Hinjewadi.

meals.description: PG meal slots required when meals are included.

near_coworking.description: True only when near coworking is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

near_transit.description: True only when near transit is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

rent_bracket.description: PG rent brackets (multi-select, INR per bed).

rent_max.description: PG max rent per bed per month (INR).

rent_min.description: PG min rent per bed per month (INR).

stay_nights.description: Desired stay length in nights (7=1 week … 330=11 months, 365=12 months). 11 months is offered everywhere; it is the standard residential lease in India.

suits.description: PG suits: working professionals or students.

name: save_pg_alert
title: Save a PG hunt alert
